links.outcome: Pathologist accuracy with versus without AI assistance in MASH histology scoring
links.effect: AIM-MASH-assisted reads were superior to unassisted reads for inflammation, ballooning, MAS ≥4 and MASH resolution, and non-inferior for steatosis and fibrosis; inter-reader variability decreased.
links.quote: AIM-MASH-assisted reads by expert MASH pathologists were superior to unassisted reads in accurately assessing inflammation, ballooning, MAS ≥ 4 with ≥1 in each score category and MASH resolution, while maintaining non-inferiority in steatosis and fibrosis assessment.

links.effect: AIM-MASH had high repeatability and reproducibility compared to manual scoring.
links.quote: AIM-MASH demonstrated high repeatability and reproducibility compared to manual scoring.

links.outcome: Accuracy of assisted versus unassisted pathology reads

links.effect: Assisted reads were superior to unassisted reads and decreased inter-reader variability.
links.quote: In a prospective, regulatory-grade study of assistance to pathologists in MASH histology scoring, AIM-MASH-assisted reads by expert MASH pathologists were superior to unassisted reads and decreased inter-reader variability.
